x: Tony Harris, Mitcham's speedy junior, led the field all the way on the 3½ mile course to set up a new course record. Mike Heck, our new member from Sheffield, looked quite comfortable and was ably supported by John Thresher and Brian Johnston.

Normally taking off for home at the 'Elliott spot' (660y to go) John cannily waited until they hit the wind with just over a lap left. Unfortunately Tony Harris (Mitcham AC) hung on to him,finally overtaking in the finishing straight for a good win.
John Thresher, now recovered from his recent injury, won his mile heat from Tony Harris(Mitcham), staying at the rear of the leading bunch for ¾ mile and then letting rip with a 58.2 last lap.

Chris Martin was beating Tony Harris (Wimbledon) all the way round in the 440 yds but just failed to hold him off 20 yds from the tape. The Belgrave man's time of 51.1 was his best and the fastest in the Club this year.
And down at Wimbledon Park in an even earlier era, Mitcham AC's Tony Harris blasted a huge half-mile field to gain a "games" qualifying time.
Frank Mitchell, left, coached Mitcham's international 800m runner Tony Harris while brother Ron, centre, will have been a Belgravian for 50 years in 1998.
